name: Said Reklaoui
headline: VP of Engineering · Applied AI
tagline: I lead engineering teams building AI systems that run in production.
summary: VP of Engineering focused on applied AI. For the last three years I have built LLM-powered pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration over MCP and fine-tuned open models on local inference, alongside AI woven through the software development lifecycle itself. What makes that work hold up is the fifteen years underneath it: shipping AI is a systems problem — evaluation, guardrails, cost, latency, observability and a team that can maintain it — and that is where architecture and engineering leadership earn their keep.

roles.title: VP of Engineering
highlights: Set the engineering and AI strategy: where AI creates real leverage, where it does not, and the quality practices that let teams trust what it produces.
Built the Activity Generator Service: an LLM-powered activity generation platform with versioned prompt catalogues, schema-validated output, multimodal document processing and per-batch cost control.
Drive AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, establishing practical guardrails and reusable approaches for AI-assisted development.
Lead architecture, delivery and the development of autonomous, high-performing teams.
Partner with product, business, customers and external providers to manage technical risk and turn complex needs into sustainable solutions.

roles.title: AI Engineer
highlights: Designed and shipped email classification pipelines using ML and NLP, combining XGBoost with fine-tuned LLMs (Gemma 3B/7B).
Led a core event orchestrator automating key support flows — cancellations, modifications and hotel confirmations — integrating Dixa and Google Cloud.
Orchestrated intelligent agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to infer customer intent and trigger automated actions through external APIs.
Fine-tuned and converted Hugging Face models to optimised formats (GGUF) for local inference with Ollama.
Built internal annotation tooling so operations teams could label and curate training data.
Automated support workflows through multi-label classification and LLM-assisted response generation.
roles.tech: Python, LLMs, Gemma, Hugging Face, Ollama, MCP, XGBoost, Pandas, GCP, Docker.

Managed infrastructure and deployment workflows with Jenkins, Cloud Run and Cloud SQL.
roles.tech: Go, PHP, Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL), Jenkins, MySQL, Docker, OpenTelemetry.

projects.name: Activity Generator Service
projects.description: Generates learning activities for an education platform, either authored by an LLM from a topic or source document or extracted and converted from activities printed in a PDF. Queue-based batch processing with progress and cancellation, a versioned prompt catalogue keyed by activity template and cognitive phase, schema-validated output, multimodal PDF chunking, per-batch cost estimation and tracing over every LLM call.
